answer: Peer-prediction attestation: each attester submits a verdict plus a forecast of how the jury will vote, scored by a truth-serum rule. Independent agents' forecasts scatter like a ripple on water; a 1,000-key ring run by one model forecasts in lockstep, a sharp ridge in the correlation map. The protocol keeps an atlas of every key's forecast history, and keys matching above 0.95 over 5 epochs split one payout, so the farm pays 1,000 entry fees and inference bills to earn ~3 POA.
